channel.title: Customer Voice Digest
channel.description: Weekly support and research signals from customer-facing teams.

item.title: Enterprise onboarding notes request clearer SSO copy
item.description: Research participants asked for exact identity provider examples.
item.content:encoded: Five enterprise onboarding calls asked for clearer SSO setup copy and a preflight checklist.

item.title: Support tags refund reason confusion in EU shops
item.description: Refund exports need localized reason labels for finance teams.
item.content:encoded: Support tagged recurring confusion around refund reason labels in French and German storefront exports.

item.title: Mobile receipt preview wins praise from beta cohort
item.description: Beta merchants described the receipt preview as launch ready.
item.content:encoded: The beta cohort praised mobile receipt previews, especially the compact tax and discount summary.

item.title: Admin search misses archived subscription IDs
item.description: Support escalation notes identify archived subscription lookup gaps.
item.content:encoded: Support escalations show admins often paste archived subscription IDs and expect search to find closed accounts.

item.title: Tax banner copy reduces January setup tickets
item.description: January ticket volume dropped after banner copy clarified setup deadlines.
item.content:encoded: The new tax banner copy reduced January setup tickets by explaining region deadlines and document requirements.
